messages:
amy: Quick triage check — ticket snapshot: 42 open, 6 P0s (2 payment, 1 embeddings, 3 auth). Blockers: stuck on payment webhook test. Macros: updated payment-refund macro in PR but needs review. Today: finish webhook repro + review macros.

kevin: I can sandbox the webhook repro, ping me with a test id. I'll try to capture request/response.

sam: embeddings P0 looks like model timeout in the dedupe worker. Added logs to ticket #4521 and will try bumping tokenization timeout.

jon: reviewed the macro PR, left 2 comments on placeholders. Amy, can you merge when CI is green?

maria: auth P0 update — token rotation issue after dedicated deploy. Starting rollback now, opening patch branch.

deploy-bot: deploy to support-macros succeeded: `macros-v2.3.1`

amy: thx @kevin and @jon. @sam — please paste the exact traceback to #4521 so infra can triage faster.

kevin: sandbox started. curl I used:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-webhook.redwood.test/events \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"id":"test-1234","event":"payment.succeeded"}'
```
Posting full request/response to ticket.

sam: added traceback and temp patch (`timeout=45`) to worker config in the ticket.

jon: merging macro PR now — running CI.

amy: small smoke test request: after merge, can someone run refund flow and confirm template placeholders render correctly?

kevin: ran refund test after merge. placeholders render OK, refund email sent.

maria: rollback complete, token rotation back to normal. Monitoring metrics for 30m.

amy: volume note: backlog: 30+ tickets older than 7d. Triage rotation this week: mornings — kevin/sam, afternoons — jon/maria. Please update your shifts in the calendar.

triage-bot: reminder: daily triage check-in at 09:30 AM PT.

amy: anything else urgent?

sam: CR ping — need approval for support-worker perf PR, @jon?

jon: looking now, should be able to approve by EOD.

amy: thanks all — I'll update the ops doc with webhook debug steps and link it here after lunch.
